This game is amazing to say the LEAST. The enemies are well designed, the game is glitchless, and the general game is just magical. The game makes you feel amazing when you mercy kill a enemy. Speaking of which i love the various mercy kill animations enough though some enemies, raveners for a example, have only one animation. The game has smooth combat with multiple fun classes and seamless character customization too, allowing you to both fight without, a lot, of lag and customize any way you want. You want to be a salamander? Go ahead and grab your flamer. A deathwatch marine? Go ahead. A chaplain or a dreadnought? Yeah... Maybe not on those but hey you still got a lot of freedom.
